question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Clear
solution: The correct answer is **"Opaque."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Clear"** means pure or easy to see through, with no marks or areas that are less transparent. (शुद्ध या देखने में आसान, बिना किसी निशान या कम पारदर्शी क्षेत्र के) • **Example**:* The water in the lake is so **clear**__ that you can see the bottom.* • ​The antonym of** "Clear"** is **"Opaque."** • The word** "Opaque" **means** **not letting light through : not transparent. (प्रकाश को अंदर न आने देना : पारदर्शी नहीं) __ • **Example**:* I find her poetry a little too **opaque**__.* • ​So, the correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Clean: **not dirty. (साफ़, निर्मल, स्‍वच्‍छ) • **Mess: **the state of being dirty or untidy; a person or thing that is dirty or untidy. (गंदगी या अव्‍यवस्‍था; गंदा या अव्‍यवस्थित व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु) • **Untidy: **not tidy or well arranged. ((वस्‍तु, स्‍थान आदि) मैला-कुचैला या अव्‍यवस्थित, अस्‍त-व्‍यस्‍त) 31:T1288, The correct answer is** "****The new software was installed by Myra on her computer."**
